verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's Memories feature explicitly carries useful context from earlier chats into future conversations, with dedicated docs on memory controls (personalize.md, customization/memories.md) and even CLI-level controls (/memories) for whether a chat can use or contribute to memories. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of cross-chat memory recall working reliably, and detail on limits/scope of what memories retain.
